definition.measurement: for each describe sentence from step 2, one fixed S0 is prompted with none/self/shuffled/foreign and the sentence is scored with teacher forcing
definition.lengths: self, shuffled and foreign prompts have exactly the same byte length
definition.reading: bits per target byte; lower is better
definition.useful: median(self better than foreign) >= 0.1 and median(self better than shuffled) >= 0.1 and >= 14/19 steps better against both
definition.harmful: the same magnitudes with >= 14/19 steps worse against both
definition.fallback: otherwise prefix_not_useful_yet; none is reported but never decides
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.expressions: the 20 expression texts are exact (reused from the frozen table)
criteria.rows: 19 paired steps (2..20); every step reports all four conditions
criteria.foreign_match: every paired step finds a foreign expression of equal byte length
criteria.decision: useful / harmful / not_useful_yet by the frozen medians and 14/19 counts
criteria.secondary: the none-vs-self difference is reported and does not decide
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R35 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256

rerun_anchors.note: R36 does not change living_core; R35 stays runnable at HEAD
